rulings.a: A1 on fuel stays the single confirmatory estimand (gross traction is fuel-derived, so it cannot corroborate A1); the bracket -0.3 to -2.3 % per +10 % is arithmetically right; keep the lower-magnitude rule (MDE at most half of 0.3 %); pre-state the fuel mean it uses (eligible mean, as the M769 deviation); make per +10 % of the median pressure primary (it cancels a multiplicative scale error)
rulings.b: defensible as an assumed range (SAE J2452 alpha about -0.3 to -0.5, so -0.2 is a conservative lower end); restate the shares as the rolling share of fuel-equivalent wheel energy (auxiliaries, warm-up and idle dilute it) and keep the product; pre-state the signs: traction negative, regeneration-to-battery slightly positive or zero
rulings.c: descriptive only; a day-clustered interval may be shown labelled 'before/after look, season/route/period confounded, not a pressure effect'; below 5 days per side: counts only; no ratio-rule placebo (it degenerated in M769)
rulings.d: feasibility-only is sound; FABDEM may be an exclusion screen only (coarse bound over 300 m or more), never a correction; the counts gate alone is not enough (see changes)
rulings.e: yes, as an owner decision quoted verbatim in the spec, the CHANGELOG and a result field scaleDecision {quote, date, source: chat, independentlyVerified: false}; M733 E1 (axle medians 1.02 to 1.03 of the placard) may be cited as consistent, never 'validated'

required_changes: regressor endogeneity: the hot snapshot rises with warm-up and speed (biases toward plus); primary = the cold-equivalent level (M733 15 C reference, daily or epoch); the snapshot is a sensitivity

pressure moves about 0.55 to 0.71 kPa per C with ambient: write design_mde from the residual pressure SD after covariates, not the raw SD; report the between-epoch variance share and an epoch-fixed-effect slope
report the observed pressure IQR (about +-3 %) and say per +10 % extrapolates beyond it except across the step
wrong-sign reading: 'inconsistent with the expected sign, confounding suspected'

B1: the 14 Jul puncture lies inside the 14-day before-window, so exclude it and check before-window stability; placebo windows must not straddle 26 Jul, the puncture or the 10 and 16 Oct steps; write the B1 MDE before any result

gate: add a resolution check; +10 % pressure moves the deceleration by about 0.004 m/s2 (about 2 %) while a 0.1 % grade gives 0.01 m/s2; require repeated same-segment opposite-direction pairs; braking is unobservable and e-POWER lift-off regeneration makes 'torque near zero' a tolerance; tertiles on ambient-adjusted pressure
risks: almost certainly 'not informative': the 0.3 % threshold is about 0.017 L/100 km
